projects.name: SentinelAI — Local AI Security & Monitoring System
projects.description: Built a privacy-first AI system using FastAPI, React, SQLite and Ollama that continuously monitors CPU, RAM, disk and processes while learning user-specific behavioural baselines. Designed a modular Behaviour Engine with multiple analyzers for resource usage, process behaviour, startup changes and long-term system drift to detect adaptive anomalies. Developed an intent-aware RAG pipeline with asynchronous health logging, WebSockets and automated PDF reporting, enabling natural language system queries grounded in local telemetry.

projects.name: Potato Disease Detection Using CNN
projects.description: Built a CNN model to classify potato leaf diseases (Early Blight, Late Blight, Healthy) from images with high accuracy. Integrated OpenCV for real-time disease detection through live camera feed, enabling practical field usage. Improved accuracy using preprocessing and augmentation.

projects.name: Quiz Battle – Real-Time Multiplayer Quiz Game
projects.description: Built a full-stack real-time multiplayer quiz platform using Spring Boot REST APIs and WebSocket (STOMP) for live game state synchronization. Designed MySQL schema with entities for Quiz, Question, GameSession, and Answer; managed data access via Spring Data JPA. Implemented real-time score updates and countdown timers.
